claim_summary: Same-family SR-IOV reads, dynamic assignment, errors, and profile unassignment.

probes.name: physical-ports
probes.command: lshwres -r sriov --rsubtype physport -m system-a --level roce --filter adapter_ids=1 -F adapter_id,phys_port_id,phys_port_type,phys_port_loc,state,config_logical_ports,phys_port_max_logical_ports,curr_eth_logical_ports --header

probes.name: effective-logical-ports-before
probes.command: lshwres -r sriov --rsubtype logport -m system-a --level eth --filter adapter_ids=1 -F config_id,lpar_name,lpar_id,lpar_state,adapter_id,logical_port_id,logical_port_type,phys_port_id,functional_state,capacity,max_capacity --header

probes.name: dynamic-assign
probes.command: chhwres -r sriov --rsubtype logport -m system-a -o a -p lpar-c -a adapter_id=1,phys_port_id=1,logical_port_id=27004002,logical_port_type=eth,capacity=2.0

probes.name: duplicate-assign
probes.command: chhwres -r sriov --rsubtype logport -m system-a -o a -p lpar-c -a adapter_id=1,phys_port_id=1,logical_port_id=27004002,logical_port_type=eth,capacity=2.0
probes.stdout: HSCL127D: HSCL1288 logical port 27004002 is already assigned to the partition.

probes.name: foreign-owner-silent-reassignment
probes.command: chhwres -r sriov --rsubtype logport -m system-a -o a -p lpar-vios -a adapter_id=1,phys_port_id=1,logical_port_id=27004002,logical_port_type=eth,capacity=2.0

probes.name: capacity-below-minimum
probes.command: chhwres -r sriov --rsubtype logport -m system-a -o a -p lpar-c -a adapter_id=1,phys_port_id=0,logical_port_id=27004003,logical_port_type=eth,capacity=0.5
probes.stdout: HSCL127D: HSCL1295 capacity 0.5 is outside the valid range 1.0 to 100.0.

probes.name: capacity-exhausted
probes.command: chhwres -r sriov --rsubtype logport -m system-a -o a -p lpar-c -a adapter_id=1,phys_port_id=0,logical_port_id=27004003,logical_port_type=eth,capacity=1.0
probes.stdout: HSCL127D: HSCL1293 total capacity would exceed 100.0; current capacity is 100.0.
